name: Should I repair or replace my old water heater?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my old water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace your water heater depends on its age, the extent of the damage, and repair cost. If your water heater is over 10-12 years old and requires a costly repair, replacement might be more economical in the long run due to improved efficiency of new models and reduced risk of future breakdowns. A technician from CG Plumbing Solutions can help assess the condition of your unit and provide an informed recommendation based on its remaining lifespan and potential repair expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing a water heater over 10-12 years old, especially if repairs are costly. New units offer better efficiency and reliability.
